title: kith-tslocal: integration test uses Box::leak for response bytes
description: crates/kith-tslocal/tests/integration.rs builds mock HTTP responses as Vec<u8> then calls Box::leak() to get a 'static [u8] reference for spawn_mock_server. The comment says 'avoids complex lifetime gymnastics in the spawn closure' but Arc<Vec<u8>> + clone into the async block achieves the same without leaking memory. The leak is inconsequential in a test context (process exits shortly after) but sets a bad example pattern. Consider Arc<Vec<u8>> instead.
